title: Startups and funding
focus: 创业 · 创始人 · 融资 · 风投 · 估值 · 股份 · 期权 · 烧钱
body:
Starting a company and paying for it: founders, funding rounds, valuations and equity. Sentences recycle opinion words from L1, work words from L16 and money words from L9 and L20.

| Chinese | Pinyin | Meaning | Why |
|---|---|---|---|
| 创业 | chuàngyè | to start a business | found an enterprise |
| 创始人 | chuàngshǐrén | founder | the one who began it |
| 融资 | róngzī | to raise funding | let capital flow in |
| 风投 | fēngtóu | venture capital / a VC | risk investment |
| 估值 | gūzhí | valuation | estimated worth |
| 股份 | gǔfèn | shares / equity | share portion |
| 期权 | qīquán | stock options | a right at a set date |
| 烧钱 | shāoqián | to burn cash | burn money |

## Which word?

**股份 vs 股票 (L26):** 股份 is your share of a company, public or private. 股票 is shares traded on a stock market. A startup employee has 股份 or 期权; a retail investor buys 股票.

**风投 vs 投资人:** 风投 is venture capital, either the industry or a VC firm. 投资人 is any investor, including angels and friends and family.

## Sentences

- 他辞职出来创业，压力确实很大。 tā cízhí chūlái chuàngyè, yālì quèshí hěn dà.: He quit his job to start a company, and the pressure is real.
- 两个创始人有矛盾，公司差点散了。 liǎng gè chuàngshǐrén yǒu máodùn, gōngsī chàdiǎn sàn le.: The two founders don't get along, and the company almost fell apart.
- 我们刚拿到A轮融资，估值翻了一倍。 wǒmen gāng ná dào A lún róngzī, gūzhí fān le yí bèi.: We just closed our Series A, and the valuation doubled.
- 说实话，这个估值不太靠谱。 shuō shíhuà, zhège gūzhí bú tài kàopǔ.: Honestly, that valuation isn't credible.
- 风投最看重的是团队和趋势。 fēngtóu zuì kànzhòng de shì tuánduì hé qūshì.: What VCs care about most is the team and the trend.
- 创始人手里还有百分之三十的股份。 chuàngshǐrén shǒu lǐ hái yǒu bǎi fēn zhī sānshí de gǔfèn.: The founders still hold thirty percent of the shares.
- 跳槽去创业公司，工资低一点，但是有期权。 tiàocáo qù chuàngyè gōngsī, gōngzī dī yìdiǎn, dànshì yǒu qīquán.: Jumping to a startup pays less, but you get options.
- 这家公司一直在烧钱，估计撑不过明年。 zhè jiā gōngsī yìzhí zài shāoqián, gūjì chēng bú guò míngnián.: This company keeps burning cash; I reckon it won't last past next year.

cards.English: to start a business / found a startup
cards.Example: 他辞职出来创业了。 tā cízhí chūlái chuàngyè le: He quit his job to start a company
cards.Notes: 创 chuàng create, found (创造, 创新) + 业 yè enterprise, line of work (企业, 事业, 毕业) = found an enterprise, so start a business. 创业公司 = a startup. 创业者 = entrepreneur.

cards.Example: 他是这家公司的创始人。 tā shì zhè jiā gōngsī de chuàngshǐrén: He's the founder of this company
cards.Notes: 创 chuàng found (创业) + 始 shǐ begin (开始) + 人 rén person = the person who began it, so founder. 联合创始人 = co-founder.

cards.Example: 我们正在融资。 wǒmen zhèngzài róngzī: We're fundraising right now
cards.Notes: 融 róng melt, blend, circulate (融化, 金融) + 资 zī capital, 贝 money (投资, 工资) = let capital flow in, so raise funding. Also a noun: 拿到融资 = close a round; A轮融资 = Series A; 天使轮 = angel round.

cards.English: venture capital / a VC (firm or investor)
cards.Example: 这家风投很有名。 zhè jiā fēngtóu hěn yǒumíng: This VC firm is well known
cards.Notes: Short for 风险投资: 风险 fēngxiǎn risk (风 wind + 险 danger, as in 保险) + 投资 tóuzī invest (L20) = risk investment, so venture capital. Like 'VC', it means both the industry and the firm. 投资人 = any investor.

cards.Example: 公司估值十亿美元。 gōngsī gūzhí shíyì měiyuán: The company is valued at a billion dollars
cards.Notes: 估 gū estimate (估计 L3) + 值 zhí worth (值得, 价值 L24) = estimated worth, so valuation. Also a verb: 估值十亿 = valued at a billion.

cards.Example: 他占公司百分之十的股份。 tā zhàn gōngsī bǎi fēn zhī shí de gǔfèn: He owns 10% of the company
cards.Notes: 股 gǔ thigh, by extension a portion or strand; in money, a share (股票, 股东) + 份 fèn portion (一份, 部分) = share portion, so equity stake. 股东 = shareholder. 占…的股份 = own …% of.

cards.Example: 公司给了我一些期权。 gōngsī gěi le wǒ yìxiē qīquán: The company gave me some options
cards.Notes: 期 qī period, set date (日期, 期限) + 权 quán right (权利) = a right you can use at a set date, so option. 股票期权 is the full form; at a startup 期权 alone is enough.

cards.English: to burn cash (spend fast without earning)
cards.Example: 这个项目太烧钱了。 zhège xiàngmù tài shāoqián le: This project burns through money
cards.Notes: 烧 shāo burn (发烧, 烧烤) + 钱 qián money = burn money. Same image as English 'burn rate'. Also casual for any money-pit hobby: 摄影很烧钱 = photography eats money.

cards.English: He quit his job to start a company, and the pressure is real.
cards.Hanzi: 他辞职出来创业，压力确实很大。
cards.Pinyin: tā cízhí chūlái chuàngyè, yālì quèshí hěn dà.
cards.Notes: 创业 (L25) + 辞职 (L16) + 压力 (L4) + 确实 (L1).

cards.English: The two founders don't get along, and the company almost fell apart.
cards.Hanzi: 两个创始人有矛盾，公司差点散了。
cards.Pinyin: liǎng gè chuàngshǐrén yǒu máodùn, gōngsī chàdiǎn sàn le.
cards.Notes: 创始人 (L25) + 矛盾 (L8). 散 = scatter, break up.

cards.English: We just closed our Series A, and the valuation doubled.
cards.Hanzi: 我们刚拿到A轮融资，估值翻了一倍。
cards.Pinyin: wǒmen gāng ná dào A lún róngzī, gūzhí fān le yí bèi.
cards.Notes: 融资 + 估值 (L25). 翻一倍 = double.

cards.Hanzi: 说实话，这个估值不太靠谱。
cards.Pinyin: shuō shíhuà, zhège gūzhí bú tài kàopǔ.
cards.Notes: 估值 (L25) + 说实话 (L1) + 靠谱 (L12).

cards.English: What VCs care about most is the team and the trend.
cards.Hanzi: 风投最看重的是团队和趋势。
cards.Pinyin: fēngtóu zuì kànzhòng de shì tuánduì hé qūshì.
cards.Notes: 风投 (L25) + 趋势 (L24). 看重 = value, weigh heavily.

cards.English: The founders still hold thirty percent of the shares.
cards.Hanzi: 创始人手里还有百分之三十的股份。
cards.Pinyin: chuàngshǐrén shǒu lǐ hái yǒu bǎi fēn zhī sānshí de gǔfèn.
cards.Notes: 创始人 + 股份 (L25). 手里 = in hand, holding.

cards.English: Jumping to a startup pays less, but you get options.
cards.Hanzi: 跳槽去创业公司，工资低一点，但是有期权。
cards.Pinyin: tiàocáo qù chuàngyè gōngsī, gōngzī dī yìdiǎn, dànshì yǒu qīquán.
cards.Notes: 创业 + 期权 (L25) + 跳槽 (L16).

cards.English: This company keeps burning cash; I reckon it won't last past next year.
cards.Hanzi: 这家公司一直在烧钱，估计撑不过明年。
cards.Pinyin: zhè jiā gōngsī yìzhí zài shāoqián, gūjì chēng bú guò míngnián.
cards.Notes: 烧钱 (L25) + 估计 (L3). 撑不过 = can't hold out past.
